Live from orbit

First, I'd like you to meet the Sentinels

My thesis uses radar images from ESA's Sentinel-1 satellite constellation. Although the first two satellites, Sentinel-1A and -1B are no longer operational (RIP), Sentinel-1C and -1D are going strong, orbiting overhead at an altitude of ~700km. Every few days, they paint a picture of what is going on in European forests. Check out where they are right now!
